title.zh: 将索索贡省卡西古兰市镇博霍村更名为圣安东尼奥村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Boho in the Municipality of Casiguran, Province of Sorsogon, to San Antonio
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Boho in the Municipality of Casiguran, Province of Sorsogon, to San Antonio
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Boho tại Thị trấn Casiguran, Tỉnh Sorsogon thành San Antonio
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Boho ในเทศบาล Casiguran, จังหวัด Sorsogon เป็น San Antonio
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Boho di Kotamadya Casiguran, Provinsi Sorsogon menjadi San Antonio
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Boho di Perbandaran Casiguran, Wilayah Sorsogon menjadi San Antonio

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2531_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Barrio Boho in the Municipality of Casiguran, Province of Sorsogon, is hereby changed to San Antonio.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
